[size=4][b]Description
[/b][/size]
Tired of slowing down to a crawl every time you walk through your dense Blue Jazz fields or a patch of grass on your farm?
By default, Stardew Valley applies a heavy movement speed penalty when walking through crops or grass. This mod removes that penalty entirely, allowing you to walk at full speed regardless of the terrain.
[center][/center]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/41466/41466-1768877810-1709850181.png[/img]


[color=#ffff00][size=4][b]Comparison: Mod vs. "Ol' Slitherlegs"
[/b][/size]
[/color]In Stardew Valley 1.6, there is a power book called [b]Ol' Slitherlegs[/b] (sold by the Bookseller) that reduces this penalty. However, it does not remove it completely.

Here is exactly how your speed changes in 4 different scenarios:

[list]
[*] [b]1. Default (No Mod, No Book)[/b]
You suffer a massive speed penalty (-100% drag). You walk very slowly through crops and grass.[*] [b]2. With "Ol' Slitherlegs" Book Only[/b]
The book reduces the penalty by about 67%. You move faster than before, but you are still slightly slowed down compared to walking on a path.[*] [b]3. With Swift Walker Mod Only[/b]
[b]Zero Penalty.[/b] The mod completely neutralizes the slowdown. You walk through grass and crops at full normal walking speed.[*] [b]4. With Swift Walker Mod AND the Book[/b]
[b]Zero Penalty (No Conflicts).[/b]The mod automatically detects that you have read [b]Ol' Slitherlegs[/b]. It adjusts its math perfectly to ensure you walk at normal speed.[i]You will not glitch out or run "super fast"—you will simply remain at your consistent, normal walking speed.

[/i][/list]
[line]
[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list]
[*] Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] (4.0 or later).
[*] Download this mod and unzip the [font=Courier New]SwiftWalker[/font] folder into your [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font] folder.
[*] Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*] [b]Safe to Install/Uninstall:[/b] This mod does not permanently change your save file. If you uninstall it, the speed penalty will simply return.
[*] [b]Crop Safety:[/b] This mod logic specifically ignores Seeds (Phase 0 crops), as the base game does not slow you down on seeds. This prevents accidental speed boosts when planting.
[/list]
